title: Design Studio Selections Scheduling Rules: Included Appointments, Electrical Walk and First Appointment
content:
**1. Included appointments.** The package includes its included number of selection appointments, each of the package's appointment hours. Only selection appointments are counted toward the included number, over the life of the file.

**2. Further selection appointments.** The clause under which each further selection appointment carries the package's extra appointment fee as a design consultation fee option line is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for billing appointments held beyond those included.

**3. Electrical walk.** An electrical walk is held once, after framing and before drywall. It is free where the package includes the electrical walk; otherwise it carries the package's electrical walk fee as a design consultation fee option line.

**4. Video appointments.** Appointments may be held by video only where the package permits video appointments.

**5. First appointment.** The first appointment should be held within the package's first-appointment days, counted in calendar days after the file was opened.

- *Clock start:* the opened date of the Design Studio Selections file, as shown on the file record.
- *Counting:* counting starts the day after the opened date and the last counted day is included.
- *Direction:* the first appointment is in time when it is held not later than the last counted day; held on the last counted day, it is in time.

**6. First appointment not held in time.** A file whose first appointment was not held in time keeps its place, but the package allowance is not granted until the first appointment is held, and structural selections close at construction start whatever has been selected.

**Boundary cases on hypothetical dates** (a package with 21 first-appointment days)

| File opened | Day 1 | Day 21 (last counted day) | First appointment held | In time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-02 | 2026-03-03 | 2026-03-23 | 2026-03-23 | Yes |
| 2026-03-02 | 2026-03-03 | 2026-03-23 | 2026-03-24 | No |

In the second row the file keeps its place; its package allowance waits until the first appointment is actually held, and its structural selections close at construction start with whatever has been selected by then.

superseded_clauses: each further selection appointment carries extra_appointment_fee_usd as a design_consult_fee option line.
